line.createDescription: Add a row to the order's run schedule. With a room it is occupied for the period, plus the layout's setup and teardown time. Leave the times empty for a line without time, e.g. a fee; empty quantity and price inherit the order's headcount and the price list or item.
line.editDescription: Change time, place, quantity, price or note. Moving it moves the occupancy. Leave the times empty for a line without time, e.g. a fee; leave quantity, price, discount and VAT empty to inherit the headcount, price list and item.
line.archiveConfirm: Do you want to remove "{name}" from the program? The room is released.
line.stateChanged: The line's state has been changed.
line.empty: The order has no lines yet.
line.occupied: The room is already occupied during this period or its changeover time.

line.expandBundleDescription: Add a bundle as one line that carries its price, plus one line per part with the part's time from the bundle's start. The parts show their own prices but do not count in the total; the quote shows VAT per rate. Leave the times empty for lines without time.

line.optionSplitHint: Split between guests: give each chosen option how many of {quantity, number} get it. Leave an option at 0 to not choose it.
line.addAddOnDescription: Add something sold with {name}: any item or free text at its own price. It starts with the line's type and time; change them if it goes to another run sheet or only part of the time. Empty quantity follows the line.
